snippet.title: Anemoiapolis Pre-release Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1522960/Anemoiapolis_Chapter_1/

The most relaxing horror game you'll ever play. Anemoiapolis exists in the uncanny valley of American architecture. Escape for your life, and enjoy the scenery. Releases this February.
